camera.meaning: Percentages describe visible world width and height relative to the native viewport.
camera.opening: 50% visible area, eased to 75% over the first four seconds of each wish.
camera.progression: 75% to 125% follows native acceleration, reaching the widest view at speed 31 pixels per physics step, about 50 seconds.
camera.simulation: Rendering only. Native 34 Hz physics, terrain geometry, collision boxes, scoring and random generation are unchanged.

animation.uniboar: Four articulated short legs, torso bob, head pitch, independent tapered rainbow mane/tail strands and flowing horn colors. HUD and intro use the same character parts.
animation.deer: Cosmetic foreground pairs leap after the widest camera view is reached. Four painted poses blend during each arc. Disabled with reduced motion.
animation.particles: 58 cached leaf/light sprites at several depths, displaced by the moving Uniboar. The Floating leaves & light setting persists locally.

audio: Three cached soft hoof/earth/leaf variations follow the same half-cycle contacts as the visible gait. Voices stop immediately on takeoff, dash, pause or death and use the existing effects-volume bus.

art.delivery: Generated originals retained; WebP copies encoded at quality 94. Runtime crops transparent parts and paints textures inside the exact terrain silhouette.

assets.brief: Original painterly forest terrain texture atlas matching the existing golden, sage-green woodland panorama. Upper half mossy stone, roots and crevices; lower half lush moss, ferns and forest floor. Natural readable rock volume and warm highlights, cohesive illustrated fantasy atmosphere. No text, characters, sky or copied game artwork.
assets.prompt: Use the attached forest panorama only as a palette and painting-style reference. Create an ORIGINAL production game terrain TEXTURE ATLAS, landscape 1536x1024 or higher, opaque. Two clearly separated horizontal bands: TOP HALF is seamless natural vertical cliff rock-and-earth material, weathered mossy dark olive and warm umber, chunky rounded ancient stones, roots weaving through small crevices, subtle shaded depth and beautiful fine painterly detail. BOTTOM HALF is seamless lush dense forest-floor moss material, cushions of soft emerald moss, tiny ferns, clover, fine grass and occasional seed husks, softly golden lit from above. Fill both bands edge to edge, no margins or labels, no paths or scenery horizon. Horizontal tiling in each band should be natural, varied and without obvious repeating landmarks. This will be clipped to irregular platform shapes and overlaid with grass, so do NOT paint platforms or silhouettes. Match the warm sunlit misty woodland palette of the reference: gentle golden highlights, sage greens, deep blue-green shadows, natural textured surfaces. Premium hand-painted 2D platform adventure material quality, tactile moss and roots, elegant atmospheric light; mood references Leo's Fortune, Ori forest environments and Silksong Moss Grotto, but keep the softer sunlit reference palette. No neon outlines, no fantasy crystals, no characters, no text, no logos, no harsh black outlines, no repeating big mushrooms.

assets.brief: Original articulated brown/bronze robotic wild boar, using the existing Uniboar identity as reference. Transparent four-part atlas: compact armored torso upper left, boar head with tusks and ears upper right, short front leg lower left, short rear leg lower right. Separate parts with consistent warm metallic lighting; no mane, tail or horn because those animate independently in the game.
assets.prompt: Create one polished production 2D articulated character PARTS ATLAS for a side-scrolling forest game, transparent background, landscape 1536x1024. Use the references for the identity (a brown compact bronze ROBOT WILD BOAR) and soft warm forest lighting. Exactly FOUR isolated sprite parts, arranged in a precise 2-column by 2-row grid, each centered with generous transparent gutters and never touching another cell. TOP LEFT: only the rounded boar TORSO, side-on facing RIGHT, no head, no legs, no tail, no mane; broad compact chest, rounded rump, brown burnished bronze overlapping organic armor, dark wood-brown recesses, subtle engraved mechanical joints at front and rear hips. TOP RIGHT: only the separate right-facing WILD BOAR HEAD and small neck collar, with a short broad snout, large visible ivory curling tusk, alert amber eye, two pointed ears, warm brown bronze plates; NO horn, NO mane, NO hair, NO background. BOTTOM LEFT: only ONE compact FRONT LEG, shown as a vertical bent articulated upper segment, round knee and a dark cloven hoof, hip attachment at top, bent modestly like an animal standing, short and stocky. BOTTOM RIGHT: only ONE matching REAR LEG, short stocky bent articulated hock and cloven hoof, hip attachment at top. All four pieces consistent scale within own cell, independent complete cutouts. The boar must feel powerful and charming, tactile detailed warm brown bronze, subtle painterly edge shading and soft golden reflections. Premium hand-painted 2D fantasy-platformer finish matching the forest reference, smoother and more natural than the old strong black-outlined cartoon reference. Preserve recognizable snout, tusk and robotic armor identity. We will animate these joints and add a flowing rainbow mane, rainbow tail and rainbow horn separately in code, so do NOT include any rainbow elements in this atlas. No text, no labels, no floor, no detached floating flecks, no borders, no scene, true transparent alpha.

assets.brief: Original warm brown woodland deer in four sequential right-facing leaping poses on a transparent two-by-two atlas. Same animal, proportions and painterly golden forest lighting across takeoff, extension, tuck and landing poses. Entire antlers and hooves inside each cell, no background, floor, text or frame.
assets.prompt: Original production game sprite sheet for decorative FOREGROUND DEER leaping through a warm magical woodland. Transparent background. Landscape 1536x1024. Exactly four complete isolated poses of the SAME elegant brown roe deer in a precise 2x2 grid with large transparent gutters. All side profile facing RIGHT. Top left: takeoff, front legs lifting and hind legs extended down-back. Top right: beautiful airborne full bound, neck reaching forward, front legs extended toward right and rear legs extended toward left. Bottom left: airborne tucked pose, all four legs neatly folded beneath belly. Bottom right: descending landing pose, front legs reaching forward/down and rear legs softly tucked. Keep each entire animal including every hoof, tiny tail, ears and small branched antlers fully inside its own grid cell. Consistent slim natural anatomy, rich chestnut coat, pale underside and muzzle, soft golden rim light, painterly fur and graceful legs, premium 2D hand-painted fantasy adventure finish coherent with the forest reference. This is a graceful natural forest animal, not a mascot, robot, horse or unicorn. Full silhouette clear at small game scale. No scene, no ground, no grass, no cast shadow, no surrounding glow cloud, no captions, no grid lines, no text. Truly transparent alpha between and around each animal. Make the dark brown coat readable against moss and mist with subtle warm edge lighting, no white outline.
